name: Filters & remotes
long_description: Clean filters keep airflow strong, protect the cooling coil and improve indoor air. A working remote keeps everyday control simple. These small parts make a noticeable difference to comfort and running cost.

parts.name: Mesh & dust filters
parts.detail: Washable air filters for indoor units.
parts.summary: Washable mesh filters in the indoor unit catch dust before it reaches the coil. Clean filters keep airflow, cooling and efficiency up.
specs: Polypropylene or nylon mesh in a plastic frame
Wash with water; dry fully before refitting
notes: Replace torn or warped filters; running without filters clogs the coil

parts.name: Carbon & anti-bacterial filters
parts.detail: Extra filtration for odours and cleaner air.
parts.summary: Add-on filters that clip onto the main mesh filter. Activated carbon reduces odours; anti-bacterial and allergen filters help keep indoor air cleaner.
specs: Activated carbon, anti-bacterial and anti-allergen media
Clips onto the main filter frame; sized per model
About every 6–12 months, depending on use
Most are not washable: replace when dirty
notes: Share your AC model so we supply the right size and frame

parts.name: Original & universal remotes
parts.summary: Replacement remotes for all common AC brands. Original remotes give every function; universal remotes cover most brands with a code or auto-search.
specs: Original (brand) remotes or universal multi-brand remotes
Universal remotes: brand code or auto-search
notes: Inverter and special functions work best with the original remote

parts.name: Drain pipes & small fittings
parts.detail: Drain hoses, clamps and small installation fittings.
parts.summary: Drain hoses, extensions, joiners and clamps for taking condensate water away from the indoor unit. Blocked or sagging drains are the most common cause of water dripping from an AC.
specs: Flexible or corrugated PVC, about 16 mm internal diameter for split ACs
For drains running through cooled spaces, to stop sweating
Joiners, extensions, elbows, adaptors and clamps
PVC pipe and fittings for cassette and ductable units
notes: Keep a steady downward slope with no dips; a drain pump is needed where gravity drainage isn't possible

signs: Dusty or musty smell from the vents
